reason: The README describes a DSH plugin whose primary purpose is connecting an agent to Trilium for durable memory and note-based knowledge management, with search and related note operations.

summaries.zh: 通过 ETAPI 将 Trilium 笔记库接入 DSH 智能体，用于持久记忆、笔记管理、全文搜索及报告、附件和日历等操作。
summaries.en: Connects a Trilium note repository to a DSH agent through ETAPI for durable memory, note management, full-text search, and related report, attachment, and calendar operations.

capabilities: Connects to a Trilium instance through ETAPI
Stores, reads, updates, deletes, restores, clones, and searches notes
Maintains agent memory and can inject a memory index at session start
Creates weekly reports, calendar notes, and attachments
Exports, imports, backs up, and retrieves note history
